note.question: What is the best way to configure the capacity of the production network and to allocate the available capacity to meet predetermined fill rate requirements?
note.overview: In many production environments, a fixed network of capacity is shared flexibly between multiple products with random demands. What is the best way to configure the capacity of the production network and to allocate the available capacity to meet predetermined fill rate requirements? The paper develops a new approach for network capacity configuration and allocation and characterize the relationship between the capacity of the network and the attainable fill rate levels for the products, taking into account the flexibility structure of the network.
